game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round, smoke serpents strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge: keep the engine_power meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: engine_power drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while engine_power > 0.
